content.executive_insights:

- **Dual Affiliation Flagged**: The same UNH profile lists a secondary title "DIRECTOR, SOUTHWEST RESEARCH INSTITUTE" beneath McConnell's name -> means the lead's current primary appointment is ambiguous between UNH Emeritus and an SwRI directorship.

- **UNH Workday (Research and Science family group)**: Returns "0 JOBS FOUND" as of the fetch on https://usnh.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers?jobFamilyGroup=Research+and+Science -> Currently no open PhD/postdoc/research openings posted through USNH HR for the lead's unit.
- **SwRI Space Sciences VP Appointment (POST-2026-01-01 anchor)**: On February 4, 2026, SwRI named Dr. Stephen Fuselier (not McConnell) as vice president of its Space Science Division (https://www.swri.org/newsroom/press-releases/swri-appoints-fuselier-vice-president-of-space-science-division, https://sciencesources.eurekalert.org/news-releases/1115131) -> This puts any "DIRECTOR, SOUTHWEST RESEARCH INSTITUTE" title for McConnell, if real, either outside the Space Sciences Division, prior, or at a different SwRI directorate.
content.identity:
- **Lead**: Mark McConnell.
- **Email (verified)**: Mark.McConnell@unh.edu (UNH directory).
- **Listed title on UNH side**: Professor Emeritus; Space Science Center (SSC) at the Institute for the Study of Earth, Oceans, and Space (EOS).
- **Listed secondary title on UNH page**: "DIRECTOR, SOUTHWEST RESEARCH INSTITUTE" - shown on the same UNH person page (https://eos.unh.edu/person/mark-mcconnell).
- **Direct line to the SSC office phone**: (603) 862-2047.
- **ResearchGate author page** lists "Mark L. McConnell's research while affiliated with University of New Hampshire and other places" (https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Mark-L-McConnell-3227972) - "other places" is consistent with an additional SwRI affiliation.
- **Namesake disclaimers**:
  - NSF search "PI last name McConnell + start date 2024-01-01" returns only **Mark W McConnell** (Oklahoma State University / Harvard, mathematics grants 1987-1997) at https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/advancedSearchResult?ActiveAwards=true&... -> DIFFERENT PERSON.
  - Senator Mitch McConnell unrelated; Marshall County BUILD transportation grant named for the senator is unrelated.
  - Former NASA astronaut "Mark N. Brown" (NASA search auto-suggests) unrelated.
content.recent_active_funding_2024_onward:
**No verified public evidence found for a competitive external grant awarded or active in McConnell's name at UNH Space Science Center with public award record, announcement, or official funder database entry since 2024-01-01.** What was checked and what came back:
- NSF Award Search, PI first name "Mark" and last name "McConnell", start date 2024-01-01 (active + expired) -> 4 results, all Mark W McConnell mathematics grants from 1988-1997 (https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/advancedSearchResult?ActiveAwards=true&...). The only 4 hits are NOT high-energy astrophysics and NOT our lead.
- NSF Award Search with advanced filter "PI last name McConnell" + "Organization University of New Hampshire" + keyword "gamma-ray" -> "Your search did not return any results" (https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/advancedSearchResult?QueryText=%22McConnell%22...). -> Confirms no matching NSF astrophysics awards under his name in the funded-PI database.
- NASA NSPIRES direct PI lookup for "Mark McConnell" returned empty results (https://nspires.nasaprs.com/external/principalInvestigator/... search URLs returned no content).
- NASA TechPort search returned a 404 page (https://techport.nasa.gov/directory?action=search&q=Mark+McConnell).
- USAspending.gov Advanced Search interface loaded but cannot be queried for keyword without parameter passing in this environment (https://www.usaspending.gov/search/?hash=...).
- UNH Today news section (https://www.unh.edu/unhtoday) newsroom listings for 2024-2025 mention several large UNH institutional awards (e.g., $8M NSF EPSCoR grant, May 14, 2024, https://www.unh.edu/unhtoday/news/release/2024/05/14/unh-receives-8m-nsf-grant-advance-new-hampshires-science-and-technology and https://www.unh.edu/unhtoday/2024/05/major-nsf-funding-will-advance-nhs-science-and-technology-leadership). These are institutional/center awards, not competitive PI grants to McConnell.
- IMAP-Lo / SWFO-L1 / TRACERS / Solar Orbiter / 3UCubed missions at UNH SSC (https://eos.unh.edu/space-science-center/missions) are mission-instrument efforts where the principal investigator listed is Nathan Schwadron ("professor of physics and astronomy and principal investigator for the IMAP-Lo instrument", https://www.unh.edu/unhtoday/2025/09/nasas-imap-launch-feature-instrument-designed-and-built-unh) -> McConnell is not named as PI of these instruments in current UNH press releases; mission budgets are also institutionally distributed and not individual grants to him.
- Recent (2024) co-authored publications include "Future Perspectives for Gamma-ray Burst Detection from Space" (April 2024) and the GRAPE polarimeter test flight poster (July 2024) (https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Mark-L-McConnell-3227972) -> co-authorship of instrument papers does not in itself confirm a competitive grant role.
content.recent_and_open_positions_2026_onward:

- Currently open research assistant, research staff, or research engineer openings.
- Currently posted recruitment to work with the lead.

A negative result was returned, not an absence-of-listings: the public-facing postings that were queried simply do not show a McConnell-tied vacancy at the time of fetch. Repeated checks at a later date could change this.

content.confidence_and_caveats:
- **Confidence level - Identity**: High. UNH person pages with matching email and space-science affiliation are consistent with all stated research topics.
- **Confidence level - Current primary employer**: Low. The "DIRECTOR, SOUTHWEST RESEARCH INSTITUTE" string on the UNH page is suggestive but not corroborated by an SwRI staff/leadership page in this run; the named current SwRI Space Sciences VP (appointed 2026-02-04) is Stephen Fuselier, not McConnell (https://www.swri.org/newsroom/press-releases/swri-appoints-fuselier-vice-president-of-space-science-division).
- **Funding scope since 2024-01-01**: Investigations returned no positive public record. The official NSF, NASA NSPIRES, and USAspending paths were each attempted; absence of database hit does not by itself prove zero funding (closed-end agency databases may not surface SwRI subawards, internal PI re-allocations, or non-PDF cooperative-agreement funding), but the requirement was for verifiable public records.
- **No claims about doctoral funding**: Per spec, the answer does not claim funds are available for a PhD unless a source explicitly connects the funding to hiring or doctoral support. No such connection was found.
- **Namesakes separated**: Mark W McConnell (Oklahoma State mathematics, NSF grants 1987-1997); Senator Mitch McConnell BUILD grant (Marshall County, 2018) are explicitly flagged so they are not merged with the named astrophysics lead.
- **Date and currency**: No exact dollar figure was returned for the lead's own grant, so no fabricated number is included.
